turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I have no doubt, Your Majesty. Now, if you will be so kind as to elucidate the specifics of your dilemma.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: Indeed, I shall divulge all. The matter at hand is most delicate and concerns my own personal honour as well as the political stability of my realm. I require your utmost discretion and assistance, Mr. Holmes, Mr. Watson.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: I am at your service, Your Majesty. Please proceed with your explanation.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: Let me begin by recounting the events that have brought me to such a predicament. It involves a matter of great personal distress and political sensitivity, one that I have kept secret for far too long.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I am prepared to hear your narrative, Your Majesty. The details will illuminate the path to a solution.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I shall proceed with caution, for the stakes are indeed high. My predicament involves a lady of great influence who has secrets that threaten not only my personal honour but also the political equilibrium of my kingdom.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I trust you will provide me with all the pertinent details, Your Majesty. Begin wherever it is most convenient for you.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: I am here to assist, Your Majesty. Please feel free to share whatever details you believe are necessary.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: Indeed, I shall. However, before I proceed, I must emphasize the utmost secrecy. The consequences of this matter becoming public could be dire, both for myself and for the future of Bohemia.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: I understand, Your Majesty. Your concerns for secrecy are well-founded. We will maintain the strictest confidentiality.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I must first explain the nature of the lady in question and the delicate situation that has arisen due to her actions. Rest assured, my intentions are noble and my actions are driven by the welfare of my people and my crown.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: Very well, Your Majesty. I shall require a detailed account of the events leading up to your current predicament. There are no trifles in this case, so every detail is of importance.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I shall begin with the events several years ago, when I first encountered the lady in question. Her beauty and charm were captivating, yet they brought with them complications that have now reached a critical point.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: I am ready to hear Your Majesty's account and assist in any way I can.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: Let us proceed with caution, as the matters I am about to disclose are of the utmost sensitivity. I shall reveal the full extent of the situation, but I require your solemn promise to uphold the confidentiality of this conversation.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I promise, Your Majesty. Confidentiality is paramount in my profession.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I understand your commitment to discretion, Mr. Holmes, and I am grateful for your understanding, Dr. Watson. Now, I shall reveal my true identity and the nature of my dilemma.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: I understand, Your Majesty. Please proceed when you are ready.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I am the King of Bohemia, and I have come to you with a matter that threatens the stability of my kingdom and could have far-reaching consequences. My former fiancée, now the Duchess of Dordrecht, holds a secret that could undermine my authority and the peace of Europe. I require your expertise to retrieve a compromising photograph that she possesses.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I see, Your Majesty. Please elaborate on the details of the photograph and the circumstances under which it was obtained.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: You had my note? I told you that I would call.

opening.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
opening.text: Pray take a seat. This is my friend and colleague, Dr. Watson, who is occasionally good enough to help me in my cases. Whom have I the honour to address?

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: You may address me as the Count Von Kramm, a Bohemian nobleman. I understand that this gentleman, your friend, is a man of honour and discretion, whom I may trust with a matter of the most extreme importance. If not, I should much prefer to communicate with you alone.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: Then I must begin. I must bind you both to absolute secrecy for two years; at the end of that time the matter will be of no importance. At present it is not too much to say that it is of such weight it may have an influence upon European history.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: You will excuse this mask. The august person who employs me wishes his agent to be unknown to you, and I may confess at once that the title by which I have just called myself is not exactly my own.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: The circumstances are of great delicacy, and every precaution has to be taken to quench what might grow to be an immense scandal and seriously compromise one of the reigning families of Europe. To speak plainly, the matter implicates the great House of Ormstein, hereditary kings of Bohemia.

opening.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
opening.text: I was also aware of that.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: If your Majesty would condescend to state your case, I should be better able to advise you.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: You are right. I am the King. Why should I attempt to conceal it?
